name: XCC_EPM_BUDGET_INT
description: This table is the open interface for EPM customers to load budget information into control budgets, single period per row.

columns.name: BUDGET_INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the budget entry transaction and this is autogenerated.

columns.name: SOURCE_APPLICATION
columns.description: The source budget application for which this interface row is budgeted.

columns.name: SOURCE_BUDGET
columns.description: Source control budget name to which this interface row is budgeted.

columns.name: DATA_SET
columns.description: Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) revision number for the budget entry transaction.

columns.name: BUDGET_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the budget entry transaction is initial budget or budget adjustment.

columns.name: BUDGET_JSON_PAYLOAD
columns.description: Budget entry transaction in JSON format encoded using Base64.

columns.name: BUDGET_AMOUNTS_MODE_CODE
columns.description: Increment or overwrite the budget entry transaction.

columns.name: FUNDS_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether funds check or funds reservation is to be performed on the budget entry transaction.

columns.name: RESULT_CODE
columns.description: Overall result of the budget entry transaction.

columns.name: PROCESS_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the budgetary control process.

columns.name: FATAL_ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Message for a fatal error. This maps to the xcc_data_sets.fatal_error_message table.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY
columns.description: Descriptive Flexfield: structure definition of the user descriptive flexfield.

columns.name: APPROVED_BY

columns.name: REVISION_DESCRIPTION

columns.description: Attachment for approval of the budget entry transaction at the header level.

columns.name: JUSTIFICATION_TEXT

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.
